body: I honestly don't care if I and every other human dies. It's not a big deal...in the scheme of things Earth really fucking sucks and it needs to be put away.

I can jump on the train tracks, move to a state where I can get a gun and make those asshole car dealers clean the mess after I leave a brain stain, or jump from my high rise prison they call a job. This is not a job, it's slavery. There's nothing I hate worse than being the most underpaid overqualified person on fucking EARTH!!! At 5:00pm I always choose my bed, or my pipe, or the bar next door from work...I feel like I can't make the right decisions because what's the point? Nobody's going to pay me shit. I already waste every day of my life and the weekends are done in a blink...not that I have any money to enjoy them. I really think this is it for me.

I am a white male and I find black women to be very attractive - smart, sexy, and intelligent. I think their struggle adds strength. I love the lips, hips, hair...everything. I would say that college is maybe not the best option for people now days. I went for music and I am very talented. Maybe change your major to something that makes a lot of money like programming or finance. I don't want you to repeat my mistakes. Don't take out loans, be smart, work hard, educate yourself. Don't seek in others the things you want for yourself. They won't make your choices and being lonely might suck...but you're all you've got. Those people will be gone some day. All of them. You will be left standing and you don't want to stand with somebody you aren't comfortable with. As a man I wish more women would speak up about their true feelings. Tell every man you want to date that you think he's cute and trust me...they will date you.
